fusion_prior_source: CAD rate of the calibration (validation) set, one ECG per duplicate group
base_classifier: StandardScaler + RBF SVC, trained by scripts/train_ecg.py (group-aware 5-fold CV on the training split)
calibration_method: Group-aware OOF multiclass logistic calibration, then binary Platt calibration on validation CAD + normal ECGs
arrhythmia_handling: Excluded from the CAD score and from fusion; returned separately
